description: Check what ACTUALLY happened to a settled transfer, against the destination chain rather than Robyn's own database. Optionally assert who should have been paid (`recipient`) and the minimum that should have arrived (`minAmount`); we decode the payout transaction's ERC-20 Transfer logs and report whether reality matches. Also cross-checks Robyn's own receipt against the chain and says so if the books disagree. THE VERDICT IS THREE-VALUED: `verified`, `failed`, or `undetermined`. Treat `undetermined` as UNKNOWN, never as success — it means the chain was unreachable, the tx is not mined, or the rail records completion as a balance delta that cannot be re-derived (Allbridge/Chainflip/Solana/Tron). Do not tell a user a transfer is confirmed on an undetermined result.

id.description: transfer id, or the source/destination tx hash

minAmount.description: minimum base units that must have arrived

recipient.description: address that must have been credited

name: robyn_verify_outcome
title: Verify a transfer against the chain
